MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  AUGUST 27, 2025
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  9:00 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Riggins called the meeting to order at 9:18 a.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Marianne Riggins; Mayor Pro Tern Bruce Silverstein; and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad, Doug Stewart and Steve Uhring.

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Candace Bond, Interim City
  Manager; Richard Rojas, Deputy City Manager; Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk; Yolanda
  Bundy, Community Development Director; Christina Muiloz, Deputy City Clerk; Gail
  Duncan, Administrative Assistant; Lauren Doyel, Contract Geotechnical Engineer; Tyler
  Eaton, Principal Planner; Carole Myers, Administrative Assistant; Mike Phipps, Contract
  Geologist/Coastal Consultant; and Patricia Salazar; Planning and Operations Manager

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Mayor Riggins led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  City Clerk Pettijohn reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  August 22, 2025.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tern Silverstein moved, and Councilmember Uhring seconded a motion
  to approve the agenda. The motion carried unanimously.

ITEM 1  WORK SESSION

  Work Session on Rebuild Policies to Facilitate the Rebuilding of Structures
  Damaged or Destroyed by Natural Disasters
  The City Council will hold a Work Session to consider the rebuild policy document
  to facilitate the rebuild of structures destroyed by natural disasters. Members of the
  public will have the opportunity to speak on each policy after a staff presentation.

  Mayor Riggins expressed condolences for the school shooting in Minneapolis. She
  encouraged members of the public to consolidate their comments.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of August 27, 2025
  Page 2 of 6

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  the staff report, an overview of Executive Orders relevant to rebuilding. Ordinance
  No. 524, permit approvals to date, and the order of items to be presented and
  structure for public comment.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 5 — Basements and Subterranean garage.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and three speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic and did not direct any changes to this section.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 6 — Water Tanks and Pools.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and four speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic and did not direct any changes to this section.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back an ordinance to exempt water
  tanks from the calculation of total development square footage for fire rebuilds.

  Mayor Riggins reopened public comment on this topic and three speakers were
  heard.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 7 — Combining square footage between multiple structures

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and two speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic and did not direct any changes to this section.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 9 — 10% increase must comply with current zoning regulations.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and four speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic and did not direct any changes to this section.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 11 — Rooftop Decks.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and eight speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of August 27, 2025
  Page 3 of 6

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back revised language to clarify
  dark sky and noise requirements.

RECESS  At 1 1 :12 a.m., Mayor Riggins recessed the meeting. The meeting resumed at 11:20
  a.m. with all Councilmembers present.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 12 — Survey Requirement.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and five speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back revised language requiring
  surveys.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. PF4.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and speakers declined the
  opportunity to speak. Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion.
  The Council discussed this topic and did not direct any changes to this section.

RECESS  At 12:00 p.m., Mayor Riggins recessed the meeting. The meeting resumed at 1:04
  p.m. with all Councilmembers present.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. PF2 — Seaward Projections.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and speakers declined the
  opportunity to speak. Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion.
  The Council discussed this topic and did not direct any changes to this section.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. PF3 — Building Code Required Interior Access).

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and two speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic and did not direct any changes to this section.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 4
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of August 27, 2025
  Page 4 of 6

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and five speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back revised language including
  structures that existed prior to the 2025 Palisades Fire in the definition of "lawfully
  erected."

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. PF 1 — Deemed Complete Applications.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and five speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back revised language to allow
  permitting the deemed complete applications as an administrative plan review with
  a site plan review.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 1 — Like-for-like.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and four speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to review the policy for consistency with
  Ordinance No. 524 and bring back more information for the Council's
  consideration.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 2 — Substantially the Same Location

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and two speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic.

  May Riggins reopened public comment on this topic and one speaker was heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back revised language clarifying
  the definition of footprint.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of August 27, 2025
  Page 5 of 6

  May Riggins reopened public comment on this topic and three speakers were heard.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 8 — No Net Loss.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and one speaker was heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council accepted the changes presented by staff.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 3 — Calculating Bulk.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and seven speakers were
  heard. Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion. The Council
  discussed this topic.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to consider cubic volume in the calculation
  of bulk.

  Principal Planner Eaton and Community Development Director Bundy presented
  on Issue No. 10 — Wave Action Report and Sea Level Rise

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor for public comment and three speakers were heard.
  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion.

  May Riggins reopened public comment on this topic and additional speakers were
  heard.

  Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion.  The Council
  discussed this topic.

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council directed staff to bring back a recommendation on this
  issue after the September 9 Coastal Engineer Professionals Meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Riggins adjourned the meeting at 5:01 p.m.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of August 27, 2025

  Approved and adopted by the City Council of the
  City of Malibu on May 11, 2026.

  BRUCE SIL ERSTEIN, Mayor
